about: Westward Waves Surf School teaches on Westward Ho! beach from a converted horse box at Northam Burrows Country Park. It runs mixed-ability group lessons, with a beach talk and about 90 minutes in the water, and one-to-one private coaching. The site also has a hire page.
where: Northam Burrows Country Park, Westward Ho!
goodToKnow: Book online, by phone or by email
gaps: The hire page failed to load, so hire items and terms are unknown. Accreditations and season were not stated.
